claims: Artemis II marks the first crewed Moon mission since 1972.
Artemis II is scheduled to launch on April 1, 2026, at 6:24 PM EDT.
Artemis II is a crewed lunar mission.
Artemis II uses SLS Rocket/Orion Capsule.
SpaceX Starlink 10-58 is scheduled to launch on April 2, 2026, between 7:52 a.m. and 11:52 p.m.
SpaceX Starlink 10-58 launches from Cape Canaveral.
Northrop Grumman CRS-24 is scheduled to launch on April 8, 2026.
Northrop Grumman CRS-24 uses SpaceX Falcon 9.
Northrop Grumman CRS-24 is an ISS resupply mission.
Northrop Grumman CRS-24 launches from Cape Canaveral.
Small Spacecraft Propulsion and Inspection Capability (SSPICY) is scheduled to launch in late 2026.
